Name: Terrane - Valley Recolor
Author: x7eventy7
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/BLupZwo.png[/img]﻿
[font=Tahoma][size=4]There are lots of recolors out there, but I absolutely love the vanilla aesthetic and just wanted some proper looking dirt.. They say the valley has the richest soil in the world, but to me it just looked like sand. Behold, the outcome of that annoyance! [/size][/font]This mod makes the valley a lot less yellow, and a lot more [i]grounded[/i]. It recolors the world with a darker palette for dirt, rocks, and cliffs. Unlike the vanilla palette, a key consideration of this recolor is consistency; the terrain now has a standardized seasonal color-scheme across the valley. By default the ground colors of different parts of the valley are different colors, but no more! Features several [font=Tahoma][size=4]recolors[/size][/font] of interiors, tilled ground, bridges, benches, fertilizer, and dig spots, to make sure everything matches the brand new ground colors and is easily readable.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wbISYFz.png[/img]﻿
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4]1. Install the latest version of [i]"[b]SMAPI﻿"[/b][/i][b][i] & "[font=Tahoma][size=4][b][i]Content Patcher[/i][/b][/size][/font]"[/i][/b][/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4]
2. Download this mod and unzip it into [i][b]"Stardew Valley/Mods"[/b][/i]
3. Run the game using [i][b]"SMAPI"[/b][/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RMo1XU0.png[/img][font=Tahoma][size=4]
◆ A uniquely fitting earthy ground color for each season
[font=Tahoma][size=4]◆ A consistent use of seasonal palettes across the valley floor
[font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4]◆ More easily readable dig spot, and fertilizer ground textures
[font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4]◆[/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font] Ginger island retains the original vanilla look with no changes
[font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4]◆ Optional snowy days that revert to the original winter look[/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font]
[font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4]◆ Toggle the recolor by season if you don't like any certain one[/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font]
◆ Reinforce the established aesthetic of vanilla Stardew Valley[/size][/font]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rgYlcA5.png[/img]﻿
[b][b][b][b][b][b][b]1.6.0+ on Linux, Mac, and Windows[/b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b]
- Support for Stardew Valley Expanded

[font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4]- Support for Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font]

[/size][/font][center][font=Tahoma][size=3][b][i]Please submit any issues, feedback or suggestions. It helps me improve the mod immensely![/i][/b][/size][/font][/center][font=Tahoma][size=4]
